title: BOX SET: English vocabulary mega-class! Learn 10 idiomatic English expressions in 25 minutes!
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】BOX SET：英語字彙大課！ 25分鐘學會10個道地英語表達！（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hello. This is The English We Speak with me, Feifei.
cues.en: Hello. This is The English We Speak with me, Feifei.
cues.zh: 你好。這是我們和我說的英語，菲菲。

cues.text: And me, Roy.
cues.en: And me, Roy.
cues.zh: 還有我，羅伊。

cues.text: Roy, what are you holding?!
cues.en: Roy, what are you holding?!
cues.zh: 羅伊，你手上拿著什麼？ ！

cues.text: This? It's a sword.
cues.en: This? It's a sword.
cues.zh: 這？這是一把劍。

cues.text: I can see it's a sword!
cues.en: I can see it's a sword!
cues.zh: 我看得出這是一把劍！

cues.text: Why do you have one?
cues.en: Why do you have one?
cues.zh: 為什麼你有一個？

cues.text: Well, I overheard you saying your friend Sandra is living in a bubble.
cues.en: Well, I overheard you saying your friend Sandra is living in a bubble.
cues.zh: 好吧，我無意中聽到你說你的朋友桑德拉生活在泡沫中。

cues.text: So I asked my pal at the museum if I could borrow a sword
cues.en: So I asked my pal at the museum if I could borrow a sword
cues.zh: 所以我問博物館的朋友我可不可以藉一把劍

cues.text: to help your friend escape!
cues.en: to help your friend escape!
cues.zh: 幫助你的朋友逃脫！

cues.text: No, Roy. I said 'Sandra lives in a bubble',
cues.en: No, Roy. I said 'Sandra lives in a bubble',
cues.zh: 不，羅伊。我說‘桑德拉生活在泡泡中’

cues.text: but it means that she doesn't really accept new ideas and all her friends
cues.en: but it means that she doesn't really accept new ideas and all her friends
cues.zh: 但這意味著她並沒有真正接受新的想法和她所有的朋友

cues.text: have the same way of thinking.
cues.en: have the same way of thinking.
cues.zh: 有同樣的思考方式。

cues.text: 'Living in a bubble' is the expression we're looking at in this programme.
cues.en: 'Living in a bubble' is the expression we're looking at in this programme.
cues.zh: 「生活在泡沫中」是我們在這個節目中看到的表達方式。

cues.text: Ahhh, that makes more sense.
cues.en: Ahhh, that makes more sense.
cues.zh: 啊哈，這更有意義。

cues.text: I just imagined that she might have got stuck in a bubble after washing her hands.
cues.en: I just imagined that she might have got stuck in a bubble after washing her hands.
cues.zh: 我只是想像她洗手後可能被困在泡沫裡了。

cues.text: Roy, your imagination never ceases to amaze me.
cues.en: Roy, your imagination never ceases to amaze me.
cues.zh: 羅伊，你的想像總是讓我驚嘆不已。

cues.text: You know what we should do?
cues.en: You know what we should do?
cues.zh: 你知道我們該做什麼嗎？

cues.text: I think we should listen to some examples.
cues.en: I think we should listen to some examples.
cues.zh: 我認為我們應該聽一些例子。

cues.text: Bob and his friends think that climate change isn't real. They live in a bubble.
cues.en: Bob and his friends think that climate change isn't real. They live in a bubble.
cues.zh: 鮑伯和他的朋友認為氣候變遷並不真實。他們生活在泡沫之中。

cues.text: Nelson lives in a bubble.
cues.en: Nelson lives in a bubble.
cues.zh: 尼爾森生活在泡沫之中。

cues.text: He never tries new food or goes out with new people.
cues.en: He never tries new food or goes out with new people.
cues.zh: 他從不嘗試新食物或與新朋友出去。

cues.text: Geraldine doesn't want to meet my new friends - she thinks they live in a bubble.
cues.en: Geraldine doesn't want to meet my new friends - she thinks they live in a bubble.
cues.zh: 傑拉爾丁不想見到我的新朋友——她認為他們生活在泡沫中。

cues.text: This is The English We Speak from BBC Learning English, and
cues.en: This is The English We Speak from BBC Learning English, and
cues.zh: 這是來自 BBC Learning English 的《我們說的英語》，以及

cues.text: we're talking about the expression 'living in a bubble' which is used to
cues.en: we're talking about the expression 'living in a bubble' which is used to
cues.zh: 我們談論的是「生活在泡沫中」這個表達

cues.text: describe someone who doesn't listen to people with different ideas, or maybe
cues.en: describe someone who doesn't listen to people with different ideas, or maybe
cues.zh: 描述一個不聽不同想法的人的人，或者也許

cues.text: is a little sheltered from society.
cues.en: is a little sheltered from society.
cues.zh: 有點遠離社會。

cues.text: I think it's sad when people live in a bubble because they don't
cues.en: I think it's sad when people live in a bubble because they don't
cues.zh: 我認為當人們生活在泡沫中時這是可悲的，因為他們不這樣做

cues.text: get to experience new ideas or have their minds changed.
cues.en: get to experience new ideas or have their minds changed.
cues.zh: 體驗新想法或改變想法。

cues.text: I don't live in a bubble.
cues.en: I don't live in a bubble.
cues.zh: 我並不活在泡沫中。

cues.text: It's why I like working with you.
cues.en: It's why I like working with you.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我喜歡和你一起工作。

cues.text: Because you have very different ideas to me and I like listening to them.
cues.en: Because you have very different ideas to me and I like listening to them.
cues.zh: 因為你和我有非常不同的想法，我喜歡聽他們的想法。

cues.text: You're always wrong, but I still like you.
cues.en: You're always wrong, but I still like you.
cues.zh: 你總是錯的，但我還是喜歡你。

cues.text: Thanks Feifei. I guess I should take this sword back to the museum.
cues.en: Thanks Feifei. I guess I should take this sword back to the museum.
cues.zh: 謝謝菲菲。我想我應該把這把劍帶回博物館。

cues.text: You should. Bye, Roy.
cues.en: You should. Bye, Roy.
cues.zh: 你應該。再見，羅伊。

cues.text: Bye.
cues.en: Bye.
cues.zh: 再見。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到我們說的英語。

cues.text: I'm Feifei.
cues.en: I'm Feifei.
cues.zh: 我是菲菲。

cues.text: And I'm Neil.
cues.en: And I'm Neil.
cues.zh: 我是尼爾。

cues.text: Hey Feifei, it sounds like you might have a cold?
cues.en: Hey Feifei, it sounds like you might have a cold?
cues.zh: 嘿菲菲，聽起來你可能感冒了？

cues.text: I think I have: sore throat, blocked nose.
cues.en: I think I have: sore throat, blocked nose.
cues.zh: 我想我有：喉嚨痛，鼻子阻塞。

cues.text: I feel terrible. That's why I'm taking this medicine.
cues.en: I feel terrible. That's why I'm taking this medicine.
cues.zh: 我感覺很糟。這就是我服用這種藥的原因。

cues.text: That's probably a good idea.
cues.en: That's probably a good idea.
cues.zh: 這可能是個好主意。

cues.text: Medicine is usually good for making you feel better but how does it taste?
cues.en: Medicine is usually good for making you feel better but how does it taste?
cues.zh: 藥物通常可以讓你感覺好一點，但它的味道如何？

cues.text: Well, it's supposed to taste of strawberries but to be honest it's just horrible!
cues.en: Well, it's supposed to taste of strawberries but to be honest it's just horrible!
cues.zh: 好吧，它應該是草莓的味道，但說實話，它太可怕了！

cues.text: That's why I never take the stuff, it's disgusting.
cues.en: That's why I never take the stuff, it's disgusting.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我從來不拿這些東西，太噁心了。

cues.text: Have you heard the phrase 'a taste of your own medicine'?
cues.en: Have you heard the phrase 'a taste of your own medicine'?
cues.zh: 你聽過「嚐嚐自己的藥」這句話嗎？

cues.text: No. Does it mean doing something horrible or unpleasant?
cues.en: No. Does it mean doing something horrible or unpleasant?
cues.zh: 不，這是否意味著做一些可怕或不愉快的事情？

cues.text: Sort of. It describes someone receiving the same, treatment or unpleasant experience
cues.en: Sort of. It describes someone receiving the same, treatment or unpleasant experience
cues.zh: 有點像。它描述某人接受相同的治療或不愉快的經歷

cues.text: that they have given to somebody else.
cues.en: that they have given to somebody else.
cues.zh: 他們已經給了別人。

cues.text: You know, like you're always bossing people around and then someone starts to boss you around?
cues.en: You know, like you're always bossing people around and then someone starts to boss you around?
cues.zh: 你知道嗎，就像你總是對別人發號施令，然後有人開始對你發號施令？

cues.text: I don't know what you mean Neil!
cues.en: I don't know what you mean Neil!
cues.zh: 我不知道你的意思尼爾！

cues.text: Anyway, it's quite a negative phrase.
cues.en: Anyway, it's quite a negative phrase.
cues.zh: 無論如何，這是一個相當消極的短語。

cues.text: It is. Let's hear some examples.
cues.en: It is. Let's hear some examples.
cues.zh: 這是。讓我們聽聽一些例子。

cues.text: Our boss is so rude to us but finally somebody has answered back and now
cues.en: Our boss is so rude to us but finally somebody has answered back and now
cues.zh: 我們的老闆對我們很粗魯，但現在終於有人回覆了

cues.text: he's got a taste of his own medicine.
cues.en: he's got a taste of his own medicine.
cues.zh: 他已經嚐到了自食其果的滋味。

cues.text: When I meet up with my boyfriend, he's always late so this time I'm going
cues.en: When I meet up with my boyfriend, he's always late so this time I'm going
cues.zh: 當我和男友見面時，他總是遲到，所以這次我要去

cues.text: to give him a taste of his own medicine and turn up late as well.
cues.en: to give him a taste of his own medicine and turn up late as well.
cues.zh: 讓他嚐嚐自己的苦果，也遲到了。

cues.text: Deepak is always rude to the teacher but he was really offended when she
cues.en: Deepak is always rude to the teacher but he was really offended when she
cues.zh: 迪帕克總是對老師無禮，但當她

cues.text: gave him a taste of his own medicine and was rude back to him!
cues.en: gave him a taste of his own medicine and was rude back to him!
cues.zh: 給他嚐到了自己的苦果，還對他無禮！

cues.text: So that's 'a taste of your own medicine' which describes someone receiving
cues.en: So that's 'a taste of your own medicine' which describes someone receiving
cues.zh: 所以這就是“嚐嚐你自己的藥”，它描述了某人接受

cues.text: the same treatment that they have given to somebody else.
cues.en: the same treatment that they have given to somebody else.
cues.zh: 他們給予其他人同樣的待遇。

cues.text: Excuse me!
cues.en: Excuse me!
cues.zh: 打擾一下！

cues.text: Oh dear. It sounds like you need to take some more medicine.
cues.en: Oh dear. It sounds like you need to take some more medicine.
cues.zh: 哦親愛的。看來你還需要吃點藥。

cues.text: If you mean literally taking the medicine, then yes but if you mean receiving the same
cues.en: If you mean literally taking the medicine, then yes but if you mean receiving the same
cues.zh: 如果您的意思是字面上服用藥物，那麼是的，但是如果您的意思是接受相同的藥物

cues.text: treatment I've given to someone else, then no.
cues.en: treatment I've given to someone else, then no.
cues.zh: 我有給別人治療過，然後就不行了。

cues.text: I can't believe you think I am always bossing people around.
cues.en: I can't believe you think I am always bossing people around.
cues.zh: 我不敢相信你認為我總是對別人發號施令。

cues.text: I was just giving an example of the phrase.
cues.en: I was just giving an example of the phrase.
cues.zh: 我只是舉了這個短語的例子。

cues.text: I would never say you were bossy.
cues.en: I would never say you were bossy.
cues.zh: 我絕對不會說你專橫。

cues.text: Good. Now why don't you go and make me a nice cup up of tea?
cues.en: Good. Now why don't you go and make me a nice cup up of tea?
cues.zh: 好的。現在你為什麼不去給我泡一杯好茶呢？

cues.text: Oh, OK, sure. See you.
cues.en: Oh, OK, sure. See you.
cues.zh: 哦，好的，當然。再見。

cues.text: And don't forget to close the door!
cues.en: And don't forget to close the door!
cues.zh: 別忘了關門！

cues.text: Yes. Sorry. I'll do that right now.
cues.en: Yes. Sorry. I'll do that right now.
cues.zh: 是的。對不起。我現在就這麼做。

cues.text: OK. See you later.
cues.en: OK. See you later.
cues.zh: 好的。稍後見。

cues.text: Ah, I feel better already. Bye.
cues.en: Ah, I feel better already. Bye.
cues.zh: 啊，我已經感覺好多了。再見。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到我們說的英語。

cues.text: I'm Feifei… And I’m Rob. And I am so excited.
cues.en: I'm Feifei… And I’m Rob. And I am so excited.
cues.zh: 我是菲菲……我是羅布。我很興奮。

cues.text: Oh yeah? Why's that, Rob?
cues.en: Oh yeah? Why's that, Rob?
cues.zh: 哦，是嗎？這是為什麼，羅布？

cues.text: You know, Feifei, it's that festive time of year: presents, parties, time with the
cues.en: You know, Feifei, it's that festive time of year: presents, parties, time with the
cues.zh: 你知道，菲菲，這是一年中的節日：禮物、聚會、與家人共度時光

cues.text: family, snow… did I mention presents?
cues.en: family, snow… did I mention presents?
cues.zh: 家人、雪……我有提到禮物嗎？

cues.text: Yes, Rob. It's Christmas time.
cues.en: Yes, Rob. It's Christmas time.
cues.zh: 是的，羅布。現在是聖誕節。

cues.text: Come on, Feifei, aren't you excited?
cues.en: Come on, Feifei, aren't you excited?
cues.zh: 來吧，菲菲，你不興奮嗎？

cues.text: Imagine if we had lots of Christmases all at the same time!
cues.en: Imagine if we had lots of Christmases all at the same time!
cues.zh: 想像一下，如果我們同時度過很多個聖誕節！

cues.text: Oh no, think of the cost of buying all those presents.
cues.en: Oh no, think of the cost of buying all those presents.
cues.zh: 喔不，想想購買所有這些禮物的費用。

cues.text: But hopefully you'd receive lots of presents too!
cues.en: But hopefully you'd receive lots of presents too!
cues.zh: 但希望您也能收到很多禮物！

cues.text: Anyway, do you know that for some people, all their Christmases can come at once?
cues.en: Anyway, do you know that for some people, all their Christmases can come at once?
cues.zh: 無論如何，你知道對某些人來說，他們所有的聖誕節都會同時到來嗎？

cues.text: I don't think so!
cues.en: I don't think so!
cues.zh: 我不這麼認為！

cues.text: OK, well, they're not really Christmases, but if someone has extreme good fortune,
cues.en: OK, well, they're not really Christmases, but if someone has extreme good fortune,
cues.zh: 好吧，好吧，它們並不是真正的聖誕節，但如果有人運氣特別好，

cues.text: it's like the feeling of having lots of Christmases all at the same time.
cues.en: it's like the feeling of having lots of Christmases all at the same time.
cues.zh: 這就像同時度過許多聖誕節的感覺。

cues.text: Got it. Having all your Christmases come at once just means 'having lots of good luck'.
cues.en: Got it. Having all your Christmases come at once just means 'having lots of good luck'.
cues.zh: 知道了。所有的聖誕節同時到來意味著「有很多好運」。

cues.text: Yes! Let's hear from some people who've had all their Christmases come at once
cues.en: Yes! Let's hear from some people who've had all their Christmases come at once
cues.zh: 是的！讓我們聽聽一些同時度過了所有聖誕節的人們的看法

cues.text: lucky them!
cues.en: lucky them!
cues.zh: 他們真幸運！

cues.text: Yeah! I got a pay rise and I'm off on holiday tomorrow,
cues.en: Yeah! I got a pay rise and I'm off on holiday tomorrow,
cues.zh: 是的！我加薪了，明天放假

cues.text: and I've won the lottery!
cues.en: and I've won the lottery!
cues.zh: 我中了樂透！

cues.text: It seems like all my Christmases have come at once!
cues.en: It seems like all my Christmases have come at once!
cues.zh: 看來我所有的聖誕節都同時到來了！

cues.text: The day I got married, I heard I'd passed my exams and got a promotion, so it felt like
cues.en: The day I got married, I heard I'd passed my exams and got a promotion, so it felt like
cues.zh: 結婚那天，聽說我透過了考試，升職了，所以感覺就像

cues.text: all my Christmases had come at once.
cues.en: all my Christmases had come at once.
cues.zh: 我所有的聖誕節都突然到來了。

cues.text: All my Christmases have come at once: my parents bought me a new car, I got a
cues.en: All my Christmases have come at once: my parents bought me a new car, I got a
cues.zh: 我所有的聖誕節都突然到來：我父母給我買了一輛新車，我得到了一輛

cues.text: place at university and I've got a new girlfriend!
cues.en: place at university and I've got a new girlfriend!
cues.zh: 我在大學裡找到了位置，而且我有了一個新女朋友！

cues.text: This is The English We Speak from BBC Learning English and we're learning
cues.en: This is The English We Speak from BBC Learning English and we're learning
cues.zh: 這是 BBC 學習英語中的《我們說的英語》，我們正在學習

cues.text: about the phrase 'to have all your Christmases come at once',
cues.en: about the phrase 'to have all your Christmases come at once',
cues.zh: 關於「讓所有的聖誕節同時到來」這句話，

cues.text: which means 'to have extreme good fortune'.
cues.en: which means 'to have extreme good fortune'.
cues.zh: 意思是「擁有極大的好運」。

cues.text: Did you know, Rob, that I've had lots of good luck?
cues.en: Did you know, Rob, that I've had lots of good luck?
cues.zh: 羅布，你知道我有很多好運嗎？

cues.text: No. What's happened?
cues.en: No. What's happened?
cues.zh: 沒有，發生什麼事了？

cues.text: Well, I've been invited to a big swanky Christmas
cues.en: Well, I've been invited to a big swanky Christmas
cues.zh: 嗯，我被邀請參加一個盛大的時髦聖誕節

cues.text: party tonight, I'm going skiing at the weekend and
cues.en: party tonight, I'm going skiing at the weekend and
cues.zh: 今晚聚會，週末我要去滑雪

cues.text: you've bought me an amazing Christmas present.
cues.en: you've bought me an amazing Christmas present.
cues.zh: 你買了一份很棒的聖誕禮物給我。

cues.text: Err, have I?
cues.en: Err, have I?
cues.zh: 呃，我有嗎？

cues.text: Yes, in that box over there.
cues.en: Yes, in that box over there.
cues.zh: 是的，在那邊的盒子裡。

cues.text: Oh, that's not for you. Sorry. It looks like not all of your Christmases have arrived!
cues.en: Oh, that's not for you. Sorry. It looks like not all of your Christmases have arrived!
cues.zh: 哦，那不適合你。對不起。看來你的聖誕節還沒到來！

cues.text: Oh well, you may as well have your present now.
cues.en: Oh well, you may as well have your present now.
cues.zh: 哦，好吧，你現在也可以得到你的禮物了。

cues.text: Hmm, a book of English phrases.
cues.en: Hmm, a book of English phrases.
cues.zh: 嗯，一本英文短語書。

cues.text: How useful!
cues.en: How useful!
cues.zh: 多麼有用啊！

cues.text: It will be. Happy Christmas, Rob!
cues.en: It will be. Happy Christmas, Rob!
cues.zh: 這將是。聖誕節快樂，羅布！

cues.text: Same to you, Feifei.
cues.en: Same to you, Feifei.
cues.zh: 菲菲，你也一樣。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak I'm Feifei.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak I'm Feifei.
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到我們說的英語，我是菲菲。

cues.text: And hello, I'm Rob.
cues.en: And hello, I'm Rob.
cues.zh: 你好，我是羅布。

cues.text: Errr, what is that smell?
cues.en: Errr, what is that smell?
cues.zh: 呃，那是什麼味道？

cues.text: Smell? I can't smell anything.
cues.en: Smell? I can't smell anything.

cues.en: I must admit, the new ones are an improvement.
cues.zh: 我必須承認，新的是一種進步。

cues.text: You're listening to The English We Speak from BBC Learning English.
cues.en: You're listening to The English We Speak from BBC Learning English.
cues.zh: 您正在收聽 BBC 英語學習節目《我們說的英語》。

cues.text: The expression we're looking at in this programme is 'to cough up'.
cues.en: The expression we're looking at in this programme is 'to cough up'.
cues.zh: 我們在這個節目中看到的表達是“咳嗽”。

cues.text: Neil, that cough is still sounding bad.
cues.en: Neil, that cough is still sounding bad.
cues.zh: 尼爾，咳嗽聽起來還是很厲害。

cues.text: Have you tried the cough medicine I use?
cues.en: Have you tried the cough medicine I use?
cues.zh: 我用的止咳藥你試過嗎？

cues.text: Not yet. It’s just a little expensive.
cues.en: Not yet. It’s just a little expensive.
cues.zh: 還沒有。只是有點貴。

cues.text: £10 for a little bottle of medicine!
cues.en: £10 for a little bottle of medicine!
cues.zh: 一小瓶藥10英鎊！

cues.text: It’s worth it. Listen, if you won’t cough up, I’ll give you the £10 back if you promise to buy it.
cues.en: It’s worth it. Listen, if you won’t cough up, I’ll give you the £10 back if you promise to buy it.
cues.zh: 這是值得的。聽著，如果你不肯付錢，如果你答應買的話我就還給你 10 英鎊。

cues.text: That’s very kind.
cues.en: That’s very kind.
cues.zh: 這非常友善。

cues.text: Not a problem.
cues.en: Not a problem.
cues.zh: 不是問題。

cues.text: And while you go to the pharmacy, I’m going to practise presenting the
cues.en: And while you go to the pharmacy, I’m going to practise presenting the
cues.zh: 當你去藥局時，我將練習展示

cues.text: programme standing on my head.
cues.en: programme standing on my head.
cues.zh: 程式站在我的頭上。

cues.text: It’s good for blood circulation, apparently.
cues.en: It’s good for blood circulation, apparently.
cues.zh: 顯然，這對血液迴圈有好處。

cues.text: Standing on your head is one thing, but presenting a whole programme? No way.
cues.en: Standing on your head is one thing, but presenting a whole programme? No way.
cues.zh: 倒立是一回事，但是呈現一個完整的方案呢？決不。

cues.text: Are you sure! £10 says I can!
cues.en: Are you sure! £10 says I can!
cues.zh: 你確定嗎！ 10 英鎊說我可以！

cues.text: Haha. OK then. Bye.
cues.en: Haha. OK then. Bye.
cues.zh: 哈哈。那麼好吧。再見。

cues.text: Bye.
cues.en: Bye.
cues.zh: 再見。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到我們說的英語。

cues.text: I'm Neil and… Erm, hi everyone. Erm, I’m Feifei and I've just …
cues.en: I'm Neil and… Erm, hi everyone. Erm, I’m Feifei and I've just …
cues.zh: 我是尼爾，…呃，大家好。呃，我是菲菲，我剛剛…

cues.text: Err… well… Feifei is here with me… Feifei, what's going on?
cues.en: Err… well… Feifei is here with me… Feifei, what's going on?
cues.zh: 呃……呃……菲菲在我身邊……菲菲，怎麼了？

cues.text: Um, yes, and today we are here, with you,
cues.en: Um, yes, and today we are here, with you,
cues.zh: 嗯，是的，今天我們在這裡，和你在一起，

cues.text: dear learners of the wonderful English language… What are you looking for?
cues.en: dear learners of the wonderful English language… What are you looking for?
cues.zh: 親愛的美妙英語學習者…您在尋找什麼？

cues.text: The script, Neil. I misplaced it somewhere… Just wing it!
cues.en: The script, Neil. I misplaced it somewhere… Just wing it!
cues.zh: 劇本，尼爾.我把它放錯地方了…就用它吧！

cues.text: Wing it? Wing, like a bird?
cues.en: Wing it? Wing, like a bird?
cues.zh: 翼它？翅膀，像鳥嗎？

cues.text: Yes, the air is fresh and I flap my wings…
cues.en: Yes, the air is fresh and I flap my wings…
cues.zh: 是的，空氣很新鮮，我拍打著翅膀…

cues.text: What are you doing? What are you doing?
cues.en: What are you doing? What are you doing?
cues.zh: 你在做什麼？你在幹什麼？

cues.text: You told me to pretend I was a bird.
cues.en: You told me to pretend I was a bird.
cues.zh: 你讓我假裝自己是一隻鳥。

cues.text: Or to tell the story of a bird or… I know lots of bird jokes.
cues.en: Or to tell the story of a bird or… I know lots of bird jokes.
cues.zh: 或講述一隻鳥的故事或…我知道很多關於鳥的笑話。

cues.text: No, that's not it.
cues.en: No, that's not it.
cues.zh: 不，不是這樣的。

cues.text: In English 'to wing' something means to improvise.
cues.en: In English 'to wing' something means to improvise.
cues.zh: 在英語中，「to wing」的意思是即興創作。

cues.text: This informal expression is thought to come from the theatre and it refers to performances
cues.en: This informal expression is thought to come from the theatre and it refers to performances
cues.zh: 這種非正式的表達被認為是來自劇院，指的是表演

cues.text: given by actors who had to learn their lines quickly while waiting in the wings.
cues.en: given by actors who had to learn their lines quickly while waiting in the wings.
cues.zh: 演員們在等待時必須快速記住臺詞。

cues.text: Ah! The wings are the space on each side of the stage, where actors wait
cues.en: Ah! The wings are the space on each side of the stage, where actors wait
cues.zh: 啊!側翼是舞臺兩側的空間，演員在此等候

cues.text: before coming onto the stage.
cues.en: before coming onto the stage.
cues.zh: 在上臺之前。

cues.text: Sometimes someone gives them their lines from there as support.
cues.en: Sometimes someone gives them their lines from there as support.
cues.zh: 有時有人會從那裡給他們臺詞作為支援。

cues.text: That's right. Let's hear how this expression is used.
cues.en: That's right. Let's hear how this expression is used.
cues.zh: 這是正確的。我們來聽聽這個表達方式是如何使用的。

cues.text: Mary spent all weekend partying instead of studying.
cues.en: Mary spent all weekend partying instead of studying.
cues.zh: 瑪麗整個週末都在聚會而不是學習。

cues.text: When I asked her why she wasn't concerned about the exam, she told me she'd just wing it.
cues.en: When I asked her why she wasn't concerned about the exam, she told me she'd just wing it.
cues.zh: 當我問她為什麼不關心考試時，她告訴我她只是即興發揮。

cues.text: The minister is a great orator.
cues.en: The minister is a great orator.
cues.zh: 部長是一位偉大的演說家。

cues.text: He's never had a speech ready, he just wings it and people love it.
cues.en: He's never had a speech ready, he just wings it and people love it.
cues.zh: 他從來沒有準備好演講，他只是即興發揮，人們喜歡他。

cues.text: So a theatrical expression for you.
cues.en: So a theatrical expression for you.
cues.zh: 所以給你一個戲劇性的表達。

cues.text: Now Feifei, do you know lots of jokes about birds? Tell me one.
cues.en: Now Feifei, do you know lots of jokes about birds? Tell me one.
cues.zh: 現在菲菲，你知道很多關於鳥的笑話嗎？告訴我一個。

cues.text: Why did the little bird get in trouble at school?
cues.en: Why did the little bird get in trouble at school?
cues.zh: 小鳥為什麼在學校遇到麻煩？

cues.text: Mmmm… no idea… Because he was caught tweeting during the test.
cues.en: Mmmm… no idea… Because he was caught tweeting during the test.
cues.zh: 嗯……不知道……因為他在測試期間發推文被抓到。

cues.text: Yes, very funny… Bye.
cues.en: Yes, very funny… Bye.
cues.zh: 是的，非常有趣……再見。

cues.text: Hi everyone, we hope you enjoyed that video and thank you very much for watching.
cues.en: Hi everyone, we hope you enjoyed that video and thank you very much for watching.
cues.zh: 大家好，我們希望您喜歡該影片，非常感謝您的觀看。

cues.text: We have so many more just like it so if you don't want to miss a single one,
cues.en: We have so many more just like it so if you don't want to miss a single one,
cues.zh: 我們還有很多類似的，所以如果你不想錯過任何一個，

cues.text: make sure to subscribe and we will see you regularly.
cues.en: make sure to subscribe and we will see you regularly.
cues.zh: 請務必訂閱，我們會定期見到您。

cues.text: Hope to see you soon. Bye guys!
cues.en: Hope to see you soon. Bye guys!
cues.zh: 希望很快能見到你。再見，夥計們！
